        int maxLength = 0;
        int countLength = 0;

                }

                isInside = false;
                checkerInside = 0;
                if (checker > 0) {
                    countWord++;
                    checker = 0;
                }
            } else {
                if (checkerInside > 0) {
                    isInside = true;
                }
            }

            if (index == length) {
                break;
            }

            if (str.charAt(index) != ')' && str.charAt(index) != '(') {
                if (!isInside) {
                    if (str.charAt(index) == '_') {
                        if (maxLength < countLength) {
                            maxLength = countLength;
                        }
                        countLength = 0;
                        isInWordOut = false;
                    } else {
                        isInWordOut = true;
                    }

                    if (isInWordOut) {
                        countLength++;
                    }
                } else {
                    isInWordOut = false;
                    if (str.charAt(index) == '_') {
                        if (checker > 0) {
                            countWord++;
                        }
                        checker = 0;
                        isInWordIn = false;
                    } else {
                        isInWordIn = true;
                    }

                    if (isInWordIn) {
                        checker++;
                    }
                }
            }

            index++;
        }

        if (maxLength < countLength) {

        }

        System.out.println(maxLength + " " + countWord);
